name: Baku Chin! Space Gambler
source: The protagonist Kirara lost his maid Izumi in a gamble at the casino. In order to rescue his beloved maid, Kirara went on a space adventure of gambling.
translation: The protagonist Kirara lost his maid Izumi in a gamble at the casino. In order to rescue his beloved maid, Kirara went on a space adventure of gambling.
